main_text.l: De reducendo enim Hiscone diversis
sententiis inter proceres contendebatur,
Ea contentio usque eò exarsit, ut Cop-
peno Iarcæo duce, qui erat Sciringicarum
partium princeps, & acerbus odii per-
secutor; naturaque turbidus & sævus,
aliquos adversæ factionis proceres in cu-
ria, in foro, in domibus suis per tu-
multum sint interempti, reliqui eorun-
dem partium magno numero, & in his
viri nobiles consulari & senatoria digni-
tate, ejecti in exilium: exules ad Keno-
nem trans Amasuim sunt profecti, auxi-
lii in inimicos communes spe. Sciringii
civitate potiti, autore eodem Coppeno,
domo egressi ex agro etiam æmulos, ad-
versæ factionis homines ejecerunt. At
biennio post, cùm flueret annus à Chri-
sto natum cccc xv, Keno Broecmerius
assiduis exulum precibus exoratus, &
ut suis quoque rebus contra Hiscônem
& socios ejus Sciringios consuleret, ex-
ercitum clam confecit, captaque per in-
sidias nocturnas urbe, & ejectis cum
Coppeno factiosissimis quibusque Scirin-
gicarum partium, exulibus & Vetcope-

page.notes: The text runs on to the next page; the word "Vetcope-" is hyphenated at the line end as printed. Long s was normalised to s; u/v spelling was normalised as instructed. The text "Hiscône" in the scan is printed as "Hiscone" with an acute-like mark possibly from the print. Check the word "Hiscone" against the scan if needed.
